en.intro: We enclose herewith the followings for your attention: -
en.arBody: Please examine the contents of the AR carefully and ensure that it is correctly completed. Thereafter, please print out the AR in TWO copies (in A4 SIZE and one-side format), arrange signature on page {page} of the AR by {signer} as the director of the Company and then return the signed AR to us ({firmAddress}) no later than {returnBy} to avoid an increased filing fee of up to {maxFee} (standard fee is {standardFee}).
en.charges: In Part 9 of the AR (page 2), please indicate whether the Company has taken out any mortgages or charges as at the made-up date (i.e. {madeUpDate}). Therefore, please CONFIRM whether the Company has taken out any mortgages or charges as at the return date and if there are such mortgages or charges, please provide us with details (e.g. bank statement as at {statementDate}) by e-mail.
en.changes: If any of the Company's particulars have changed since last year, please let us know before signing.
en.agmBody: We have prepared and enclosed herewith the following documents of the captioned company for your signatures arrangement. Please examine the contents of the documents carefully and ensure that they are correctly completed. Thereafter, please print out the documents in ONE copy (A4 SIZE and one-side format) and then return the signed documents to us ({firmAddress}). We should be grateful if you could return the signed resolution to us as soon as possible.
en.directorsSole: Written Resolutions of the Sole Director
en.membersSole: Written Resolutions of the Sole Member in lieu of an Annual General Meeting for the Year {year}
en.membersMany: Written Resolutions of the Members in lieu of an Annual General Meeting for the Year {year}
en.signHere: Please sign on the signature line.
en.agmNote: Please note that by signing and returning the written resolutions, you agree that the Company need not send you the notice as prescribed under section 559(1)(a) of the Companies Ordinance informing you that the written resolutions have been passed.
en.cddIntro: To keep our records up to date, please also send us the following:

tc.subjectArAgm: {company} - {year}年度周年申報表及周年大會文件
tc.intro: 隨函附上以下文件，敬請查閱：
tc.arHeading: {year}年度周年申報表（「周年申報表」）— 結算日期為{madeUpDate}
tc.arBody: 請仔細核對周年申報表內容，確保填寫無誤。其後請將周年申報表以A4紙單面列印兩份，由董事{signer}於周年申報表第{page}頁簽署，並於{returnBy}或之前將已簽署的周年申報表交回本公司（{firmAddress}），以免須繳付最高達{maxFee}的較高登記費（標準費用為{standardFee}）。
tc.charges: 周年申報表第9部（第2頁）須註明公司於結算日期（即{madeUpDate}）是否有任何按揭或押記。請確認公司於該日期是否有任何按揭或押記；如有，請以電郵提供詳情（例如截至{statementDate}的銀行結單）。
tc.changes: 如公司資料自去年起有任何變更，請於簽署前通知我們。
tc.agmBody: 我們已為上述公司擬備以下文件，請安排簽署。請仔細核對文件內容，確保填寫無誤。其後請將文件以A4紙單面列印一份，並將已簽署的文件交回本公司（{firmAddress}）。煩請盡快交回已簽署的決議。
tc.membersSole: 唯一成員書面決議（代替{year}年度周年成員大會）
tc.membersMany: 全體成員書面決議（代替{year}年度周年成員大會）
tc.agmNote: 請注意：簽署並交回書面決議，即表示您同意公司無須按《公司條例》第559(1)(a)條向您發出書面決議已獲通過的通知。
tc.cddIntro: 為更新我們的紀錄，請一併提供以下文件：

sc.subjectArAgm: {company} - {year}年度周年申报表及周年大会文件
sc.intro: 随函附上以下文件，敬请查阅：
sc.arHeading: {year}年度周年申报表（「周年申报表」）— 结算日期为{madeUpDate}
sc.arBody: 请仔细核对周年申报表内容，确保填写无误。其后请将周年申报表以A4纸单面打印两份，由董事{signer}于周年申报表第{page}页签署，并于{returnBy}或之前将已签署的周年申报表交回本公司（{firmAddress}），以免须缴付最高达{maxFee}的较高登记费（标准费用为{standardFee}）。
sc.charges: 周年申报表第9部（第2页）须注明公司于结算日期（即{madeUpDate}）是否有任何按揭或押记。请确认公司于该日期是否有任何按揭或押记；如有，请以电邮提供详情（例如截至{statementDate}的银行结单）。
sc.changes: 如公司资料自去年起有任何变更，请于签署前通知我们。
sc.agmBody: 我们已为上述公司拟备以下文件，请安排签署。请仔细核对文件内容，确保填写无误。其后请将文件以A4纸单面打印一份，并将已签署的文件交回本公司（{firmAddress}）。烦请尽快交回已签署的决议。
sc.membersSole: 唯一成员书面决议（代替{year}年度周年成员大会）
sc.membersMany: 全体成员书面决议（代替{year}年度周年成员大会）
sc.agmNote: 请注意：签署并交回书面决议，即表示您同意公司无须按《公司条例》第559(1)(a)条向您发出书面决议已获通过的通知。
sc.cddIntro: 为更新我们的记录，请一并提供以下文件：
